points.title: Project Scope and Complexity
points.description: The scope and complexity of your e-commerce website development project are crucial factors that determine the cost. For simple online stores with standard features, costs typically range from $1,000 to $8,000. However, more advanced e-commerce sites requiring custom functionalities, such as b2b ecommerce web development, may cost between $10,000 and $20,000, depending on the project’s complexity.

points.title: Custom Features and Functionalities
points.description: Custom features and functionalities significantly impact the cost of e-commerce web packages. Basic features like product catalogs and shopping carts may add $2,000 to $4,000. More advanced features, such as custom payment gateways, personalized user experiences, or integration with third-party systems, can increase costs to $6,000 to $10,000, based on the level of customization required.

points.title: Platform and Technology Choice
points.description: The choice of platform and technology also affects development costs. Building an e-commerce site on popular platforms like Shopify or WooCommerce might cost between $1,000 and $7,000. For more robust platforms such as Magento or custom-built solutions for b2b ecommerce web development, costs can range from $8,000 to $15,000, depending on the project's scale and requirements.
